description: Tests proxy lines from any provider with one request each (the AeonProxy proxy tester): whether the proxy answers, the HTTP status, latency, the exit IP and its country; SOCKS5 lines also get a UDP check. Accepts host:port:user:pass, user:pass@host:port or scheme://user:pass@host:port. Up to 10 lines per call without signing in, 50 when signed in. Testing AeonProxy lines uses a few KB of their traffic.

protocol.description: how to talk to the proxies (lines with a scheme:// keep theirs)
